name: Tierra del Fuego
about: Summer (Nov–Mar) is Antarctic cruise season and best for the Beagle Channel and penguin colonies; winter (Jun–Aug) brings real skiing at Cerro Castor, the world's southernmost ski resort.
overview: South America's tip — Ushuaia, Argentina's 'End of the World' and gateway for Antarctic cruises, plus skiing and Beagle Channel wildlife.
costOverview: Ushuaia itself is reasonably priced for a remote town — the real spending happens if you add an Antarctic cruise, which anchors the top of this range on its own.
